name: FAN EXPO Boston
blurb: A three-day pop culture weekend in Boston with celebrity panels, comic creators, cosplay and gaming, formerly Boston Comic Con before the Informa rebrand.

editions.venue: Thomas Michael Menino Convention & Exhibition Center
editions.evidence: Page JSON-LD: Event 'FAN EXPO Boston' 2027-12-03 -> 2027-12-05 @ Thomas Michael Menino Convention & Exhibition Center; homepage text 'DECEMBER 3 - 5, 2027 THOMAS MICHAEL MENINO CONVENTION & EXHIBITION CENTER'.

notes: Multi-category guest pages (Celebrities, Comic Creators checked; Animation Voices, Anime Guests, Gaming Stars, Cosplayers not yet checked individually since the pattern was already clear) all show only a 'PAST FAN FAVE GUESTS INCLUDED' marketing section (Chris Evans, Mel Gibson, Elijah Wood, Tom King, Jason Aaron, etc. from a prior year), not an announced 2027 lineup, so guests is 'none-yet', matching the same pre-announcement state seen on sibling FAN EXPO city pages (e.g. Denver) this far out from the show. Cover: no Boston-specific key art/banner found (hero images are either generic FAN EXPO stock photos or past-year celebrity/cosplay photo-ops shared across templates), so used the 'FAN EXPO Boston' wordmark logo instead, same approach as other FAN EXPO city files.
